newsitem.title: GERMANY: ATHLETICS-JOHNSON SHOWS HE IS READY FOR ATHENS.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-JOHNSON SHOWS HE IS READY FOR ATHENS.

text.p: Allen Johnson of the U.S. showed he is in top form for next month's world championships in Athens by running a year's best in the 110 metres hurdles on Sunday.

The Olympic and world champion clocked 12.97 seconds, just 0.06 of a second off Briton Colin Jackson's world record set at the 1993 world championships, delighting the crowd at the Stuttgart international meeting, the last before Athens.
Cuba's Anier Garcia was second in 13.11 with Olympic bronze medallist Florian Schwarthoff of Germany third in 13.21.
Olympic silver medallist Ana Fidelia Quirot of Cuba also set a year's best of 1:55.78 in the women's 800 metres.
Trinidad's Ato Boldon, the Olympic 100 and 200 metres bronze medallist, also set a year's best in the 200 metres with 19.77.
